candidates.violated_requirement: Gray code conversion from binary should use XOR operations, but OR operation is used instead, causing incorrect Gray code sequence after the first increment
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value (use an internal wire variable initialized to 0) 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation 3. Increment the binary value by 1 4. Convert the incremented binary back to Gray code 5. Output the resulting Gray code
